name: Lupin III: Umi ni Kieta Hihou
original_name: ルパン三世 海に消えた秘宝
source: Lupin stole a golden pen and takes Jigen along with him to a Greek port town by the Mediterranean Sea. It is there where he encounters a boy called Theo who lives with his grandfather Clark. It seems that it isn't just Lupin who is after the treasure...
